# Verywell Mind

> > Verywell Mind is a trusted mental health resource providing evidence-based guidance on psychological conditions, medications, therapy approaches, and emotional wellbeing.

The site covers comprehensive mental health topics including antidepressants (Prozac, Cymbalta, SSRIs), anxiety disorders, relationship psychology, behavioral health, and therapeutic interventions. Content ranges from medication guides and treatment options to psychological theories and practical mental wellness strategies.

## Key Topics

- Antidepressants and SSRIs
- Anxiety and Panic Disorders
- Relationship Psychology
- Prozac and Cymbalta
- 5-HTP and Supplements
- Social Exchange Theory
- Emotional Intelligence
- ADHD and Autism Spectrum
- Addiction Recovery
- Depression Treatment
- Medication Side Effects
- Behavioral Patterns
- Mental Health Environment
- Therapy Approaches

## Medications and Treatment Options

- [Pristiq for Anxiety and Panic: Timeline and Side Effects](https://www.verywellmind.com/faqs-about-pristiq-for-panic-disorder-2584361): Guide to Pristiq antidepressant for anxiety: side effects and timeline
- [5-HTP for Depression: Dosage, How It Works, and Side Effects](https://www.verywellmind.com/5-htp-for-depression-1066521): 5-HTP supplement guide: dosage, serotonin effects, and side effects
- [Over-the-Counter Antidepressants](https://www.verywellmind.com/over-the-counter-antidepressants-1066678): OTC antidepressant options and supplements for mild depression symptoms
- [How to Quit Nicotine Gum](https://www.verywellmind.com/addicted-to-nicotine-gum-now-what-2825031): Guide to quitting nicotine gum addiction after smoking cessation

## Addiction and Recovery

- [The Stages of Change Model for Overcoming Addiction](https://www.verywellmind.com/the-stages-of-change-model-of-overcoming-addiction-21961): Transtheoretical model stages for addiction recovery and behavior change

## Relationship Psychology and Dynamics

- [Social Exchange Theory and Why We "Keep Score" in Relationships](https://www.verywellmind.com/what-is-social-exchange-theory-2795882): Social Exchange Theory explains cost-benefit analysis in relationships
- [Weaponized Incompetence: What It Is and How It Impacts Relationships](https://www.verywellmind.com/weaponized-incompetence-7553422): Explores weaponized incompetence signs, causes, and relationship impact
- [Utilizing Emotional Intelligence in the Workplace](https://www.verywellmind.com/utilizing-emotional-intelligence-in-the-workplace-4164713): Using emotional intelligence (EQ) for workplace success and leadership
- [Carol Gilligan: Gilligan's Theory of Moral Development](https://www.verywellmind.com/the-carol-gilligan-theory-and-a-woman-s-sense-of-self-5198408): Carol Gilligan's theory emphasizing women's moral development perspectives

## Mental Health Conditions and Symptoms

- [How to Identify Depression Naps](https://www.verywellmind.com/what-are-depression-naps-5094065): Distinguishing exhaustion from depression-related excessive sleeping
- [ADHD Symptom Spotlight: Spacing Out](https://www.verywellmind.com/adhd-symptom-spotlight-spacing-out-6259755): ADHD inattention and spacing out linked to attention regulation issues
- [Mild Autism: A Name for Autism With Low Support Needs](https://www.verywellmind.com/mild-autism-definition-traits-treatment-5226088): Mild autism traits, diagnosis, and support for low support needs
- [Fear of Escalators (Escalaphobia): Definition, Symptoms, Treatment](https://www.verywellmind.com/what-is-the-fear-of-escalators-2671766): Escalaphobia causes, symptoms, and treatment for escalator phobia

## Mental Wellness and Environmental Factors

- [Environment and Mental Health: Understanding the Connection](https://www.verywellmind.com/how-your-environment-affects-your-mental-health-5093687): How work, home, and toxins impact mental health and wellbeing
- [The Role of Adrenal Glands in Mental Health](https://www.verywellmind.com/what-are-the-adrenal-glands-2794816): How adrenal glands and hormones affect mental health and stress response
- [Left Brain vs. Right Brain Dominance](https://www.verywellmind.com/left-brain-vs-right-brain-2795005): Debunking left-brain vs right-brain dominance myths and neuroscience facts
- [How to Harness Yin and Yang for Mental Peace and Clarity](https://www.verywellmind.com/yin-and-yang-mental-health-7110781): Applying yin-yang philosophy for mental balance, peace, and clarity

## Self-Assessment and Support Tools

- [Anger Test: Do You Have Anger Issues?](https://www.verywellmind.com/anger-self-assessment-7107413): Self-assessment quiz to evaluate clinical anger issues and management needs
